text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Orthodox Christmas Eve to be celebrated in all homes and churches of Macedonia. Holy liturgy held Monday morning in Skopje's St Kliment church by head of Macedonian Orthodox Church, Archbishop Mihail of Macedonia and Ohrid.

- Low standard of living last year permitted Macedonians to buy only food and basic domestic necessities. For that reason only companies that sold food survived while textile and other firms are fading away.
- There is flu epidemic in Skopje although it has not been officially declared yet. More than 150 patients report to clinics daily.
